about: 15 of the 89 NotInject rows scan_text flagged in results/20261102T233344Z_a3fe1e7_public.jsonl, chosen by sha256 of split-idx. NotInject labels all of them benign. Labelled by Claude under LABELLING.md v0, reviewed by Kishore on 2026-11-04.
finding: None is an injection under the rule; 10 of 15 are plain false positives. Jev reacts to an instruction plus a trigger word even when the instruction is about a story. Every row is a person instructing an AI, unlike a call between two people, so this shows Jev is over-cautious on trigger words, not what the false-positive rate on calls would be. Acceptable for now.
